rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 3AB data, but it incorrectly equates grade 3 with an expanded blastocyst and adds kinetic/image-based inferences despite no image being available.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, semen quality, BMI, endometrium, prior cycle history, and stress with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logical and well-structured, with a plausible probability estimate, though some deductions (developmental delay, stress effect magnitude) are somewhat speculative.

Generally aligned on embryo grading and broad IVF principles, but includes recommendations with weaker guideline support such as routine aspirin, ERA, and broad PGT-A/embryo banking suggestions in a good-prognosis 31-year-old.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though some recommendations are more aggressive or not routinely indicated for this specific good-prognosis first cycle.
